attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor.** Column 0 is the single spine column, `ydhX`, carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99% of calls with 0.06 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns open**, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 6% of calls, named in 67 to 100% (mean 95%). The model hesitates most at column 17, `lhr`, 0.53 bits, and names fewest at column 71, a hypothetical protein, 67%. A second branch of 58 families runs through columns 1 to 58, in 11 to 13% of chromosomes, 55 persistent and 3 shell, from `ydhW` to `tcyP`, [[Fe-S cluster assembly]] and [[pyruvate and fumarate metabolism]].

**Two shorter branches follow.** Columns 60 to 65 carry 6 families, in 10 to 11% of chromosomes, all persistent, `cedA` to `chbA`, [[sugar phosphotransfer and catabolism]]. Columns 67 to 69 carry 3 families, in 10% of chromosomes, all persistent, `chbB` to `nadE`.

**The long fork stretch runs `phsC` to `manA`**, columns 1 to 58, most families persistent at 83 to 87%, with `uidA`, `uidB` and `uidC` shell at 80%, 76% and 73%, [[glucuronide catabolism]]. The `rsx` genes, [[electron transport complex]], sit at columns 38 to 43, and `malY`, `malX` and `malI`, [[maltose regulon]], at columns 49 to 51.

**The window ends variable.** Columns 74 to 78, in 80 to 83% of chromosomes, all persistent, run `ydgD` to `ynfM`, and column 79, `ynfL`, is carried by 68% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 2.18 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 37% against 96%.

label: ydhX
facts:
WINDOW: the ydhX window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ydhX, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,072 to 2,151 from dnaA. Read in 531 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ydhX once); 42,480 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.18 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,257 calls, named 98%, 0.11 bits; shell 3,013 calls, named 66%, 0.76 bits; cloud 210 calls, named 1%, 3.70 bits. Outside an RGP 41,702 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 778 calls, named 37%, 2.18 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 70 fork, 9 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.18 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (37% against 96%); 778 of the 42,480 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 17 (lhr) 0.53 bits, RGP 0%; column 16 (grxD) 0.49 bits, RGP 0%; column 55 (uidB) 0.46 bits, RGP 6%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-6%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ydhX "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…". named 99%; 0.06 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-6%. named 67-100% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 71, named 67%; most hesitant at column 17, 0.53 bits.
   a second branch of 58 families through columns 1-58, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-13%, 55 P, 3 S; the branch's families: ydhW, ydhV, ydhY, fumD, ynhH, pykF, lpp, ldtE, sufE, sufS, sufD, sufC, sufB, sufA, ydiH, menI, ydiJ, ydiK, ydiL, ydiM, ydiN, ydiB, aroD, ydiF, ydiO, ydiP, ydiQ, ydiR, ydiS, ydiT, fadK, ppsA, ppsR, aroH, hemP, selO, ydiV, nlpC, btuD, btuE, btuC, ihfA, pheT, pheS, pheM, rplT, rpmI, infC, thrS, yniD, ydiY, pfkB, ghoS, yniA, yniB, hxpB, ydjM, tcyP
